title: Move off the openmls git pin when 0.10.x is released
description:
Cargo.toml pins openmls to a git rev on mimid's branch mimid-0.9.2 in
seven places, because mimid needs types 0.9.x does not export (bead for
PR #2351) and draft features that are opt-in upstream.

## Estimate, as of 2026-11-26

0.10.0-rc.1 was tagged 2026-11-23. 0.9.0 took 22 days and 4 release
candidates from its first rc, which would put 0.10.0 around mid-December
2026. Not a commitment by the openmls maintainers, just the shape of the
last release.

They are NOT waiting on IETF work: every draft feature in the tree is
behind an opt-in feature flag with none in `default`, so a draft that
moves does not hold the release.

## Done when

Cargo.toml depends on a published openmls 0.10.x from crates.io, with
the mimid-0.9.2 patches either upstream or carried as a documented
`[patch]` with a reason.
